verdict.rationale: Global Accounts come with local bank details for receiving bank transfers via local payment methods and SWIFT across 60+ markets. That implies account and routing numbers exist, but the pack never shows a finance lead viewing them on demand. Nothing in the evidence covers generating a bank verification letter. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of viewing account/routing numbers in the dashboard or API, any bank verification or account confirmation letter capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
